comments.text: I went to school for music, ended up having to get a factory job to sustain my life until I could finish my degree. Now i'm making more money in this factory job, but I want to go back to school. The problem now is... why would I? I'm building a retirement, i have insurance. I SO want to be a music teacher. But the idea of putting myself back into the programs, taking on more debt, just to make the same or LESS money is sad. If the money wasn't an issue, of course I'd teach. Now I just teach a little on the side and do music for fun, which I guess works out. Not ideal, but it's a compromise made due to the nature of capitalism. 😢
comments.author: @joshbuchholz1658
